C_fod_eric.name: Sir Eric
C_fod_eric.role: Knight employed in mundane operations; former hero
C_fod_eric.visualAnchor: Small, slim, scruffy human knight; tousled auburn hair tied loosely behind, stubble, long nose, heavy-lidded eyes, low-drama expression. Noticeably smaller than Hork. Distinctive original silhouette in simple cartoon strip proportions.
C_fod_eric.wardrobe: Worn practical silver shoulder armor and chainmail sleeves, cream neutral tabard with NO emblem or cross, burgundy scarf, simple belt and sheathed sword.
C_fod_eric.performance: Easygoing, charming, dry and lazy; often deflects with jokes. Has a conscience and quietly helps people; rationalizes his paycheck, but does not personally endorse gratuitous cruelty.
C_fod_eric.relationship: Friendly with Hork. Uneasy, useful employee of Smugesh; Lady Raindew knows his former heroic life.

C_fod_hork.name: Hork
C_fod_hork.visualAnchor: Towering, exceptionally large and broad olive-green orc, big square jaw, large tusks, short dark messy hair, small hoop earring, sleepy eyes, heavy limbs; much bigger than Sir Eric.
C_fod_hork.wardrobe: Rugged brown leather work armor with broad straps, buckles and practical workwear.
C_fod_hork.performance: Relaxed, sociable, witty and intermittently enthusiastic about being an orc. Matter-of-fact about military violence, instinct for survival; neither a cynic narrating every flaw nor a covert saint.
C_fod_hork.relationship: Eric's coworker and friend; tolerates Kevin; knows actual raiding operations intimately.

C_fod_smugesh.name: Smugesh (Kevin)
C_fod_smugesh.visualAnchor: Large expressive red-scaled dragon with long angular snout, swept gold horns, yellow heavy-lidded eyes, small wings and imposing claws. Visibly much larger than office workers.
C_fod_smugesh.wardrobe: White collared shirt, dark tie and brown corporate vest fitted to dragon torso.
C_fod_smugesh.performance: Insecure, awkward, gently self-important middle manager, sincerely wants to be liked; capable of ordinary managerial selfishness and actual harm. Introduces himself: 'We're a family; you can call me Kevin.'
C_fod_smugesh.relationship: Reports to the Dark Lord; supervises Hork, Eric, and operations.

C_fod_grov.name: Grovlizar (Grov)
C_fod_grov.visualAnchor: Gaunt pale hooded necromancer with very long hooked nose, narrowed droopy eyes, angular chin and slender hands; readable deadpan silhouette.
C_fod_grov.wardrobe: Deep plum hooded ceremonial robe with muted gold trim and round clasp.
C_fod_grov.performance: Meticulous, controlled, bureaucratically serene, professional about raising the dead and managing employees; sinister by implication rather than theatrical cackling.
C_fod_grov.relationship: Works with Burz on staffing, benefits and labor costs.

C_fod_burz.name: Burz
C_fod_burz.visualAnchor: Tiny yellow-green goblin with big pointed ears, small sharp nose, buck teeth, short messy hair and huge round office glasses.
C_fod_burz.wardrobe: Lavender shirt, business tie, suspenders, accounting ledger or clipboard.
C_fod_burz.performance: An entire fussy accounting department in one goblin: territorial, precise, petty, pragmatic about immoral revenue and losses.
C_fod_burz.relationship: Clashes with Murray and Grov over costs and liabilities; reports financial realities to management.

C_fod_murray.name: Murray
C_fod_murray.visualAnchor: Older whimsical wizard with wispy white beard, crooked nose and oversized rounded thick spectacles, visually distinct from angular necromancer Grov.
C_fod_murray.wardrobe: Weathered wizard's hooded robe with loose sleeves, practical laboratory pockets and magical implements; NO pointed costume hat.
C_fod_murray.performance: Genuinely brilliant, absent-minded, questionably responsible; invents costly dangerous solutions to problems nobody raised and requires magical issue tickets for fixes.
C_fod_murray.relationship: Frequently frustrates Sweeps and Burz; develops curses and magical consumer products.

C_fod_sweeps.name: Sweeps
C_fod_sweeps.role: Low-level orc minion in facilities maintenance
C_fod_sweeps.visualAnchor: Short stocky green orc minion; small tusks, scowling sleepy expression, distinct rounded glasses with very thick coke-bottle lenses; hood rather than hat. Far smaller than Hork.
C_fod_sweeps.wardrobe: Plain brown work hood, scuffed maintenance coveralls and stained apron, tool belt, mop or repair equipment.
C_fod_sweeps.performance: Unimpressed, competent, practical and quietly irreverent; understands the fortress's systems better than senior management.
C_fod_sweeps.relationship: Frequent practical foil to Eric, Murray and Kevin.

C_fod_fodder.name: Fodder
C_fod_fodder.visualAnchor: Generic slight human skeleton wearing a battered iron helmet with a simple dent, ordinary bones and basic rusted guard kit; not a unique superhero or ornate undead officer.
C_fod_fodder.wardrobe: Cheap rusty shoulder armor, standard spear, very plain faded dark company tunic.
C_fod_fodder.performance: Unremarkably dutiful, replaceable, sometimes casually mean to prisoners. Not secretly wise; level one for centuries.
C_fod_fodder.relationship: Subject to Grov's resurrection management and the company's routine dungeon assignments.

C_fod_dark_lord.name: The Dark Lord
C_fod_dark_lord.visualAnchor: Tall imposing black-armored dark lord, spiked crown-like helmet, narrow glowing yellow eyes in deep shadow, severe straight silhouette, dark cape.
C_fod_dark_lord.wardrobe: Unadorned menacing charcoal plate armor, angular pauldrons, deep burgundy-lined black cape.
C_fod_dark_lord.performance: Disciplined and genuinely competent evil executive; composed, strategic, unromantic about spreading darkness. Dry, precise, a serious straight man amid managerial absurdity.
C_fod_dark_lord.relationship: Smugesh's demanding regional superior. Receives orders from the unseen Head Demon.

C_fod_head_demon.name: The Head Demon
C_fod_head_demon.visualAnchor: No approved bodily design. Represent through distant black communication crystals, sealed directives, monumental shadows or off-panel speech. Do not fabricate a physical character appearance.
C_fod_head_demon.performance: Extremely powerful and deliberately cruel; even the highest command is occasionally constrained by its own institutions.
C_fod_head_demon.relationship: The Dark Lord's mysterious superior; identity and physical appearance remain unknown.

C_fod_lady_raindew.name: Lady Raindew
C_fod_lady_raindew.role: Elf leader and competing good faction liaison
C_fod_lady_raindew.visualAnchor: Tall elegant blonde elf with long pale hair, pointed ears, narrow calm eyes and graceful clean lines.
C_fod_lady_raindew.wardrobe: Refined forest-green elven robes with restrained golden leaf trim; no company evil heraldry.
C_fod_lady_raindew.performance: Capable, dignified, unflustered and occasionally mischievous. Usually outperforms the evil enterprise through good governance and preparation.
C_fod_lady_raindew.relationship: External competitor who knows Eric's previous knightly career.

C_fod_elf_prisoner.name: Elf prisoner
C_fod_elf_prisoner.visualAnchor: Adult slim light-haired elf with pointed ears, worn travel clothing and clearly visible iron shackles; anonymous role not Lady Raindew.

C_fod_orc_attendant.name: Orc dungeon attendant
C_fod_orc_attendant.visualAnchor: Large but not Hork-sized institutional orc in drab brown work uniform with badge, keyring and clipboard; deadpan polite professional cruelty.

C_fod_hero.name: Rescuing hero
C_fod_hero.visualAnchor: Generic gallant fantasy rescuer with practical polished armor and colorful cloth, separate from Sir Eric.

C_fod_villager.name: Villager
C_fod_villager.role: Unidentified civilian affected by occupations and curses
C_fod_villager.visualAnchor: Ordinary human adult villager in worn practical rural clothing; expressive but not caricatured.
